content:
We update Apple's official certified refurbished product store every week with the latest inventory. This week's picks include MacBook Neo, brand new MacBook Air configurations, Apple Watch Ultra 3, and more.

Apple's certified refurbished product store is a great way to save money, with up to 15% off, and purchases are made directly from Apple's official website, so you can buy with complete peace of mind.

Here's what you need to know:

  • Guaranteed quality at affordable prices
  • Undergoes a rigorous refurbishment process before being sold
  • Comes with Apple's one-year limited warranty
  • Eligible for Apple's 14-day return policy
  • AppleCare service can be added to the purchase
  • Engraving and gift wrapping services are not available for refurbished products

We track every addition and removal at the Apple certified refurbished product store to save you time. Inventory changes quickly, and we hope this report helps you know what's available so you can grab your favorites before they sell out.

Mac computers

The MacBook Neo and MacBook Air remain the most attractive deals. Whether you're joining the Apple ecosystem for the first time or looking to upgrade to an Apple Silicon product, both are excellent choices.

MacBook Neo

  • MacBook Neo with 256GB storage: $599 (originally $799 for a new unit)
  • MacBook Neo with 512GB storage and Touch ID: $679 (originally $799 for a new unit)

MacBook Air

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 512GB storage and 16GB RAM: $1,099 (originally $1,299 for a new unit)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 1TB storage and 16GB RAM: $1,529 (originally $1,799 for a new unit)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 2TB storage and 16GB RAM: $1,949 (originally $2,299 for a new unit)

iMac

  • 24-inch M4 iMac with 256GB storage and 16GB RAM: $1,269 (originally $1,499 for a new unit)
  • 24-inch M4 iMac with 512GB storage and 16GB RAM: $1,439 (originally $1,699 for a new unit)

Studio Display

A few weeks ago, we were the first to report that the Studio Display XDR was available at the Apple refurbished store. As always, a reminder that inventory can change quickly, and the Studio Display XDR is no exception. As of today, only two configurations remain in stock:

  • Studio Display XDR with standard glass and tilt- and height-adjustable stand: $2,799 (originally $3,299 for a new unit)
  • Studio Display XDR with nano-texture glass and tilt- and height-adjustable stand: $3,059 (originally $3,599 for a new unit)

Apple TV 4K

The long-awaited basic Apple TV 4K is back in stock this week, along with the always-available higher-end version with Ethernet connectivity. The basic version always sells quickly, so grab one while you can.

  • Apple TV 4K (3rd generation) with 64GB storage, Wi-Fi: $169 (originally $199 for a new unit)
  • Apple TV 4K (3rd generation) with 128GB storage, Wi-Fi + Ethernet: $209 (originally $249 for a new unit)

Apple Watch Ultra

I wear an Apple Watch Ultra 3 every day. If you're looking to join the club, the Apple refurbished store has some great deals this week:

  • Apple Watch Ultra 3 (GPS + Cellular), 49mm black titanium case with black Ocean Band: $679 (originally $799 for a new unit)
  • Apple Watch Ultra 3 (GPS + Cellular), 49mm natural titanium case with Anchor Blue Ocean Band: $679 (originally $799 for a new unit)

As always, to stay up to date on the latest Apple deals all week long, check out 9to5Tools.
